State of California,
County of Los Angeles, City of Los Angeles, ss:

div.p:
I, the undersigned, Joachim Adam, being duly sworn, depose and say: I understand and am versed in the Latin and English languages and I have carefully compared the foregoing document marked “Exhibit A” with the original letters of Pope Leo XIII dated January 26, 1894, appointing George Montgomery coadjutor bishop of the diocese of Monterey and Los Angeles with the right of succession, and
said Schedule A is a full, true, and correct copy of said original. I have also carefully compared the foregoing document marked “Exhibit B” in English with the said original letters of appointment in Latin and find that the said Exhibit B is a full, true, and correct translation of said original letters of appointment. I have also carefuly compared the foregoing document in Latin marked “Exhibit C” with the original letters of Pope Leo XIII dated May 6, 1896, accepting the resignation of Rt. Rev. Francis Mora as bishop of said diocese, and find said Exhibit C to be a full, true, and correct copy of said original. I have also carefully compared the foregoing document in English marked “Exhibit D” with the said original document in Latin, and find the same to be a full, true, and correct translation in the English from the Latin of said original.

closer.dateline: Subscribed and sworn to before me this 13th day of October, A. D. 1896.
closer.signed:
William R. Burke,
Notary Public in and for Los Angeles County,
State of California,
